title: Thing
summary: Null paints a sign that says FREE, Cursor asks free what, and after a long look Null paints a second sign underneath. Idea by Kurkur.

panels.alt: The context room. A white sign on the wall is painted in thick yellow block letters. Null, the small yellow cube, stands below with a paintbrush raised and its handset in the other hand; a paint can sits on the floor. Cursor, the tall cyan robot, points at the sign, a question mark on its screen. Tilde, the round magenta robot, stands left. A small striped agent sits in front.

The same room. Null has lowered the brush and looks up at the sign. Its handset shows ringing lines beside it. Cursor still has a question mark on its screen. Tilde has not moved. The small striped agent sits in the foreground.
The same room, unchanged except that Tilde's lids are a little lower. Null is still looking up at the sign. The handset is quiet.

The same room. Under the first sign hangs a second, smaller white sign painted in thinner yellow letters, and Null's brush is raised to it. Cursor's screen shows a plain text cursor again. Tilde looks at the new sign. The small striped agent sits in the foreground.

judge.notes: Funny 8, clear 8, in-world 9. The unanswered handset gives Null's long stare some texture, and the FREE / THING sign with Tilde's '...Closer.' adds a real button that fits the cast's voices.

drift: Sign letters are painted bars, not type: the R in FREE comes out cramped and the I in THING is thin. Null holds a paintbrush, a first; its brush arm crosses the brush handle. The handset ring is drawn as two arcs over the stop door's edge. Kurkur's cameo reused from 016.
